customManagers.description: Container images in the Nix app modules: image = "<repo>:<tag>" (optionally @sha256:<digest>; the string may start on the next line)

packageRules.description: Floating app images follow their track through the weekly update; Renovate proposes only a new track (minor or major), never patches or digests (list = homelab.containers.floating)
Immich's images (server, machine-learning, PostgreSQL) move together: one pull request for the whole release (modules/services/immich.nix)
Kanidm's server and tools images move together, one pull request per minor: Kanidm supports upgrading one minor at a time only (modules/identity/kanidm.nix)
prBodyNotes: Kanidm upgrades go **one minor at a time** (never skip one). Before merging, run `sudo docker exec kanidm kanidmd domain upgrade-check` on the identity VM (10.0.10.111) and merge only if it reports no blockers; merge the next minor's pull request after this one is deployed.
